# Cadomalo

> Cadomalo is an online gift shop run by Fokebo LLC (Wilmington, DE, USA). We specialize in personalized graphic tees, print-on-demand apparel and digital downloads for birthdays, anniversaries, weddings, baby showers and just-because moments.

## Brand
- Name: Cadomalo
- Legal entity: Fokebo LLC
- Founded: 2026
- Country: United States (Delaware)
- Tagline: Gifts that say more than words
- Mission: Help people send the right gift — thoughtful, personal, beautifully made.

## What we sell
- Print-on-demand personalized graphic t-shirts (fulfilled via Printify)
- Digital downloads (e.g. ClaritySheet — a multilingual personal-finance Excel planner)
- Gift bundles and curated collections by occasion

## Categories
- Birthday gifts
- Anniversary gifts
- Wedding gifts
- Baby & new-arrival gifts
- Digital downloads (instant delivery)
- Just-because gifts

## Contact
- General: support@cadomalo.com

## Policies (summary)
- Standard items: 30-day return window
- Personalized items: returnable only if defective
- Digital downloads: non-refundable once delivered
- Shipping: free over $50; physical orders dispatched in 1–3 business days
- Payment: Stripe, supports cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal
- Currencies: USD, EUR
- Ships to: 150+ countries
